brief: Codex 2625b68: ONE whole-Simm supporting palette, material-only JSON override, geometry held
status: proposal for Codex's native study; not approved; A1 unpassed
how_the_source_materials_are_built: Each target is Principled BSDF with Base Color = Mix (MULTIPLY, fac 1) of Color1 (a flat factor) and cloth_tone.png. Blender's glTF exporter writes this as baseColorFactor = Color1 with baseColorTexture = cloth_tone.png. The override replaces ONLY Color1 / baseColorFactor; the cloth_tone texture, UVs, roughness, specular and everything else stay as they are.
colour_conventions: factor_linear is the multiply factor in linear RGB (Blender Color1, glTF baseColorFactor). factor_srgb is the same factor encoded to sRGB 0-255, for reading only. The visible colour is factor x cloth_tone texel, so final pixels are darker than factor_srgb.

overrides.region: trousers only: 1,080 body faces, rest Z 0.160 to 0.590 (top of the boot to the hip), weighted to thigh and shin bones
overrides.intent: brown-olive, still the darkest cloth mass under the yellow jacket; slightly lighter and warmer than the charcoal green

overrides.region: backpack: 628 faces, all behind the back (rest Y 0.079 to 0.234, Z 0.613 to 0.987), weighted to the chest bone
overrides.intent: warm khaki-brown canvas, same value as now; yellower and lighter than the red-brown boot leather so the two browns stay apart

overrides.region: the two front shoulder straps: 56 faces, rest Y -0.147 to 0.072, Z 0.629 to 0.980, chest bone
overrides.intent: dark brown webbing, darker than the pack and the undershirt so the straps read against the jacket

overrides.region: pack seams and top binding only: 192 faces, rest Y 0.109 to 0.240, Z 0.861 to 0.991, chest bone
overrides.intent: a darker brown than the pack canvas, keeping the seam contrast it has now

shared_use: Each target is used on PROTECTED_BODY only in the region listed (checked face by face). The four materials also sit in material slots of the hidden REFERENCE_FAILED_OLD_HEAD object, but on 0 of its faces. In review the copies are applied only to the shown body; the source file is unchanged. No unintended body region found, so nothing was split or edited.
reference_reading: Full approved reference, Simm region, lit pixels (median sRGB): pack about 122, 76, 33; trousers about 95 to 110, 64 to 78, 28 to 39; boots about 104, 57, 27. These include warm sunlight, so the proposal keeps the hue direction (warm brown pack, brown-olive trousers) but not their saturation or value.

godot_untested.apply_as: for each source material: albedo_color = proposed_factor_linear converted the way the importer converts baseColorFactor (expected but not verified here: Godot 4's glTF importer converts the linear baseColorFactor to an sRGB albedo_color, so the inspector should show factor_srgb / 255); keep albedo_texture = cloth_tone
